svg.title: Video Template I ComfyUI workflow — Documentary
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production ComfyUI workflow for Documentary. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Detailed S6 flow; S3-light and S4/S5 variants are explicit scale exceptions/overlays. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.aria-label: Workflow title, profile and runtime status
g.text: Video Template I · Documentary ComfyUI Workflow
Shared seven-phase ComfyUI node graph · one node per agent · sockets · spline handoffs
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Detailed S6 flow; S3-light and S4/S5
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
Revise thesis, rights or portrayal plan.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
Repackage or reclear only failed endpoint.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

ComfyUI node legend and operating notes
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative. systemic learning
